books.title: Biostatistics and Research Methodology for Postgraduates
books.audience: MD/MS/DNB · NEET SS · INI-SS · Faculty interviews · BCBR
books.description: A question-and-answer textbook that takes you from research question to critical appraisal: concepts explained clearly, with exam-ready structured answers.
highlights: Part A: Research Methodology. EBM, study designs, clinical trials, bias, sample size, ethics, scientific writing
Part B: Biostatistics. Data, distributions, hypothesis testing, statistical tests, regression, diagnostic tests, survival analysis, meta-analysis

books.title: Biostatistics and Research Methodology: Rapid Review Handbook
books.description: The condensed companion to the main textbook: the core of each important question, for quick revision before university exams, NEET SS and INI-SS.
highlights: Same Part A / Part B structure as the textbook
Built for the last weeks before the exam
